subject: Proposed MAP: Integration execution plan & owners — SDK / streaming / tool-calls / outputs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Sharma <aditi@omnihealth.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T14:12:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo recap + draft MAP milestone: integration execution plan

Hi Aditi / Ben —

Thanks again for today's call. Quick recap and next steps so we have alignment on the MAP milestone focused on Integration Execution (SDK integration, streaming, tool-calls, structured outputs). I uploaded a working draft of the MAP with milestone owners and timelines (link below).

High level summary:
- Goal: Production-ready integration for OmniHealth triage assistant (SDK + streaming + tool calls) by target close date of 2027-01-28 (aim to ship pilot integration).
- Primary dependencies: security questionnaire completion, API keys & test dataset, dedicated dev sandbox access, and procurement approval for dedicated capacity (if required).

Draft milestones and owners (please treat as starting point we can adjust):
1) SDK integration & auth wiring — owner: Diego Fernandez (SE) — 3 weeks (dev + unit tests)
2) Streaming + low-latency validation — owner: Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng) — 2 weeks (staging tests)
3) Tool / external system calling (EHR lookup stub) — owner: Priya Natarajan (Prod Eng liaison) — 2 weeks (end-to-end test)
4) Structured outputs & schema validation (JSON schema + fallback) — owner: Evelyn Hart (ML infra) — 1.5 weeks
5) End-to-end pilot + QA — owner: Sean Gallagher (AE) & Jordan Blake (CS) — 1 week

Immediate asks for OmniHealth:
- Can you confirm target pilot data set availability and whether we get sandbox API keys the week of 12/13?
- Security/compliance: legal has the SOC2 checklist, but we need the person who will own answers (I copied Legal Ops email for visibility).

I've attached a concise SDK spec and the current MAP workbook. I also linked the editable MAP in Drive so we can assign dates/tasks directly.

Next sync: I propose a 30-min touch on 2026-12-09 to finalize owners/timelines. Let me know if that works.

Thanks —
Sean
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: omnihealth_map_v0.2.xlsx (workbook), sdk-integration-spec.md (spec)

From: Aditi Sharma <aditi@omnihealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Legal Ops <contracts@omnihealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-05T16:01:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + draft MAP milestone: integration execution plan

Thanks Sean — great recap. We like the structure. Quick responses: 
- Sandbox: we can provision sandbox API keys and a redacted test dataset; ETA 12/14 (internal ticket created).
- Security: Sarah Liao (security owner) will handle the SOC2 checklist; I added Legal Ops for contract / procurement notes.
- Procurement: Ben will drive the procurement timeline; he flagged potential billing approval steps that could add ~1 week.

One ask: for the tool-calls milestone, our EHR vendor requires a signed integration addendum before we hit their sandbox. Can we scope that as a dependency in the MAP? Also, can you call out approximate effort (dev hours) per milestone so we can budget resources on our side?

Aditi
Director, Product Integrations
OmniHealth

---
On 2026-12-05 14:12, Sean Gallagher wrote:
> (see above)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Sharma <aditi@omnihealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + draft MAP milestone: integration execution plan

Thanks Sean / Aditi — adding some implementation detail and rough effort estimates so the MAP is actionable. I updated the SDK spec attached with auth snippets (OAuth + API key fallback) and an example stream client.

Effort estimates (rough):
- SDK integration & auth wiring — 24-32 dev hours (1 dev, 3 weeks w/ testing)
- Streaming + low-latency validation — 16-24 dev hours (bandwidth on infra tweaks for batching)
- Tool-calls (EHR stub) — 20 dev hours + ~2 days legal addendum turnaround (external)
- Structured outputs & schema validation — 12-16 dev hours (schema + unit tests + fallback)

Dependencies I flagged in the MAP workbook:
- Signed EHR integration addendum (external)
- Sandbox API keys + test dataset (OmniHealth)
- Access to sample patient IDs (redacted) for end-to-end flows
- Procurement approval for dedicated capacity (optional, if you want guaranteed latency SLOs)

Action for internal team: Priya, can you confirm a point-of-contact on engineering side for any entitlement/infra requests? Marissa, I'll need a staging token and one hour next week to validate streaming behaviour with a simulated load.

Diego
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sdk-integration-spec.md (updated)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditi Sharma <aditi@omnihealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-06T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + draft MAP milestone: integration execution plan

Diego — noted. Internal POC for OmniHealth entitlements will be me. I'll request the sandbox VPC peering details from infra and chase that in parallel with the EHR addendum.

I've added a new column in the MAP workbook for "blocking owner" vs "implementation owner" — for example, Legal Ops will be blocking owner for the EHR addendum while I am the implementation owner for tool-call wiring.

I'll also add estimated calendar dates in the Drive sheet today. 12/09 cadence works for me.

Priya
Platform Engineer (Integrations), Redwood Inference

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Aditi Sharma <aditi@omnihealth.com>, Ben Turner <ben.turner@omnihealth.com>
Cc: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-07T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: MAP update: owners & ask list (finalize on 12/09)

Aditi / Ben —

Thanks all for quick responses. I've updated the Drive MAP with new columns (blocking owner, estimated dev hours, tentative dates) and attached the v0.2 workbook. Please review the assigned owners below and confirm by EOD 12/08 so we can lock the 12/09 sync: 

Assigned owners (final working list):
- SDK integration & auth wiring — Diego Fernandez (owner)
- Streaming + low-latency validation — Marissa Cole (owner)
- Tool / EHR calls — Priya Natarajan (implementation owner); Legal Ops (blocking owner for addendum)
- Structured outputs & schema validation — Evelyn Hart (owner)
- Pilot QA & go/no-go — Jordan Blake + Sean Gallagher

Omni asks outstanding: sandbox keys ETA (12/14?), confirmation of redacted test data, EHR addendum timeline.

If agreeable, we'll use 12/09 10:00am PT for a 30-min MAP finalization call (invite forthcoming).

Sean

Attachments: omnihealth_map_v0.2.xlsx, streaming-testplan.pdf
